task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Solve a 0/1 knapsack (values [11, 3, 4, 3, 12], weights [5, 3, 5, 1, 5], capacity 10) by building a penalized QUBO in dimod (slack-variable encoding for the capacity constraint) and sampling with SimulatedAnnealingSampler. Compare to brute force. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
